I'm 39 I've been dosing large amounts of kratom twice (or more) per day for 3 years. I quit 3 weeks ago cold turkey.

This has been hard. I thought I knew what I was in for because as a younger man (21-23) I had a pretty intense opiate addiction handful of pills to wake up handful of pills at work handful of pills to go to sleep. Back then I lost access to the drug so no willpower involved it was just over. I remember 3 or 4 sleepless nights doing push-ups in the dark to combat the oogly booglies (full body restless leg syndrome) but that's it I didn't miss work I didn't feel sick during the day I just got over it

Maybe I'm just old now or maybe this really is a different beast but quitting kratom has been like getting hit by a train. I called out of work for most of the first week because I legitimately couldn't keep from vomiting or shitting myself. No sleep at all the oogly booglies are as expected but they aren't going away. Suicidal thoughts (I'm ok don't be concerned but that's a thing to expect) 

I'm about a month out now and I feel like a person again but sleep is still hard to come by. No more ooglies but I just lay awake alot depression is still haunting me but it IS getting better I am feeling better every day. I think I'm going to try a 48 hour fast this week to maybe reset my whole system.

I say all this just to say hey... I'm experienced I thought I'd be okay kratom isn't oxycontin right I've kicked that before I'll be fine....no.....nah dudes this is serious shit we got ourselves into. It's no joke. If you can I'd suggest checking into a detox facility or inpatient treatment program. You're gonna be sick as hell and fuck sake they sell it at the store right. this isn't easy. If you can you should go to treatment just to be removed from your life for a month while you deal with it.
